Title: Introduction to Neural Networks
Summary: The video begins with an overview of neural networks, introducing the concept through a cartoon eye graphic and a recap of the network's structure. It sets the stage for the main goals: explaining gradient descent and analyzing how hidden layers detect features like edges and patterns in handwritten digits. The video explains the core idea of gradient descent as a method for minimizing a cost function. It defines the cost function as the average of squared differences between predicted and actual outputs across training data, emphasizing its role in measuring network performance.
